'''Tasha Tamazarian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]]. Tamazarian was based inside the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]] and sometime after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], she encountered a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents that had [[Mission to Tazan|infiltrated]] the base. Due to the fact that she was slightly deaf, the agents were able to sneak up on Tamazarian and take her captive, and they forced her to help them to extract some [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] communication protocols from the facility's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system. While Tamazarian did not want to aid the agents, she viewed her situation pragmatically and realized that she didn't have much choice, so she went along with their requests while looking for an opportunity to run away.
